scientificBoundaries: These are census-copy probabilities at a single neutral marker, not inferred genome-wide diversity, speciation or estimated FST.
D(i,j)=pi(1-pj)+(1-pi)pj assumes uniform, independent draws with replacement from selected copy pools. The same physical copy can be selected twice in a diagonal pair.
Observed Aa resident count/N uses actual genotypes and can differ from H=2p(1-p). A difference alone does not diagnose inbreeding, selection or another causal mechanism.
Within H chooses one island by census weight wi=Ni/sumN, then two copies from that island. It is not the conditional same-island portion of globally pooled draws, which would use squared weights.
Pooled H weights each ordered island pair by wi*wj. The gap is algebraically twice the census-weighted allele-frequency variance, and its displayed difference is in percentage points.
The artificial teaching arrangements are static comparisons of identical organism genotypes and IDs, not successive generations or simulated evolutionary events.
Deliberately selected or searched examples are not random trials. No breeding, migration, mutation or expedition RNG consumption occurs during inspection.
Empty-source pair probabilities and observed fractions are undefined rather than zero. Empty islands contribute zero weight to nonempty aggregate censuses.
